title: Weekly sync scratchpad — Customer Omega VPC/On-prem
content:
Meeting: Customer Omega — weekly deployment sync (prep + follow-ups)
Date: 2026-03-10 (notes updated)
Attendees: Ryan G., Aisha K., Jamal O., Leila P., Customer: S. Nakamura (infra), M. Singh (security)
Purpose: keep momentum on VPC peering, air-gapped delivery schedule, and infra validation before staging cutover.

Agenda (prep)
- Quick status from customer (5m)
- Network/VPC peering progress + remaining IP/route decisions (10m)
- Air-gapped onboarding checklist: shipment ETA, install window, offline license key (10m)
- KMS/HSM integration and secrets flow (10m)
- Test plan for smoke tests + perf targets for dedicated gpux nodes (10m)
- Blockers / escalation points (5m)
- Action items & owners (5m)

Status snapshot (as of today)
- Peering: customer completed BGP config on their edge, needs confirmation of route propagation into their firewall. (Owner: S. Nakamura)
- Transit: we proposed 10.0.0.0/22 for the staging subnet; customer requested split /23; still pending network CIDR decision.
- Hardware shipment: vendor confirmed pallet ship 2026-03-18, ETA to customer DC 2026-03-23. (Logistics owner: Jamal)
- Installer: internal offline installer built (v0.9.3-offline); RSA fingerprint shared. Need customer OK on install freeze window.
- KMS: initial KMS integration doc reviewed by security; customer uses vault-hsm v2, requires test key rotation before cutover. (Owner: Leila)
- Smoke test checklist: basic inference, kvcache warmup, quantized model load <90s. Perf targets to confirm with infra team.

Open blockers
1) Firewall drops during route-propagation testing — customer saw intermittent drops. Need packet captures from their edge and our peering box. (Action: Customer to attach pcap; Ryan to triage with SRE) — Risk: medium-high — ETA: 2026-03-12
2) CIDR split request: if customer insists on two /23s we may need to update route tables and our deployment templates. Impact: additional NAT/gateway config. (Owner: Ryan / infra templates) — Decision needed by 2026-03-14
3) HSM integration test failing on keywrap at rotate step in staging. Error: 'invalid key handle' — (Owner: Leila / customer sec) — Blocking KMS approval. Target debug session 2026-03-11.
4) Installer checksum mismatch reported on customer's test VM (checksum mismatch of v0.9.3-offline). Possible transfer corruption. (Owner: Jamal + customer infra) — Ask for retry via SFTP and alternative sha256.

Notes to self (scratchpad)
- Bring up the '/networking/edge-config' playbook PR during sync; PR link in linked_artifacts.
- Check whether dedicated gpux profile supports sequenceLen=4096 in quantized mode — ping infra eng.
- Prepare a one-pager for cutover rollback steps in case of failed smoke tests.
- Confirm support window: our on-call will be available 2026-03-23 08:00-20:00 UTC.

Action items (clear, owner, due)
- Customer: upload BGP packet captures + firewall logs (S. Nakamura) — due 2026-03-12
- Jamal: reupload offline installer via SFTP and verify sha256 + log transfer (Jamal O.) — due 2026-03-11
- Leila: run HSM rotation debug run with customer sec in pairing session; capture trace (Leila P.) — due 2026-03-11
- Ryan: make decision doc for CIDR split impact and share with customer + infra team (Ryan G.) — due 2026-03-14
- Ryan/Aisha: schedule dry-run smoke test with staging nodes after hardware arrival (Owners: Ryan & Aisha) — schedule by 2026-03-20
- Infra: confirm gpux perf baseline and sequenceLen compatibility (Infra Eng: TBD) — due 2026-03-15

Escalation notes
- If HSM rotation not resolved by 2026-03-12, escalate to Security EM and open a Priority-1 channel with vendor.
- If packet captures show persistent drops after route fix, consider temporary mirrored tunnel for debugging; notify SRE.

Prep questions to ask customer in meeting
- Can you confirm maintenance window constraints for 2026-03-23? Any blackout periods?
- Who is primary contact for onsite networking vendor during hardware install?
- Any local compliance or transport hold that could delay pallet release?

Next steps / next meeting
- Weekly sync same time next week (2026-03-17) unless earlier break-fix needed.
- I'll send updated action tracker and attach packet-capture template + sha256 instructions after this note.

Quick links (for meeting)
- linked confluence: CONFLUENCE-Private-Deploy-Customer-Omega
- jira board: PD-482
- installer PR: github.com/redwood-inference/ops-configs/pull/128

Quick status shorthand (for subject line update)
- Peering: partial
- Installer: retest
- KMS: blocked
- HW: shipping

End scratchpad. Will trim and paste into the weekly email after the sync.
